Here is a sample Semgrep rule for the vulnerability you've provided:

```yaml
---
id: "vuln-tabby-1c077147"
title: "Improper Certificate Validation in Tabby SSH Client"
description: "The application uses an outdated and potentially vulnerable version of the ssh2 library. The 'authHandler' function does not verify host keys before attempting to authenticate, leading to a potential Man-In-The-Middle attack."
severity: WARNING
languages:
  - typescript
metadata:
  cve: CVE-2024-48460
  cwe: CWE-295
pattern:
  - "file:('tabby-ssh/src/session/ssh.ts') AND function:('authHandler')"
  - "call(promisify('crypto.createPublicKey'))"
  - "call(promisify('sshpk.parse'))"
  - "call(promisify('fs.readFileSync'))"
---
```

This rule will match if the 'authHandler' function in the file 'tabby-ssh/src/session/ssh.ts' is called with a promisified version of any of these functions: 'crypto.createPublicKey', 'sshpk.parse', or 'fs.readFileSync'.

Please note that this rule might need to be adjusted based on the actual codebase and the specifics of the vulnerability.
